content.title: Sporting vs Bodo: Odds, Confirmed Lineups, Prediction and Bet Builder Tip
content.text: Tournament: Champions League Venue: Estadio Jose Alvalade Date: 17.03.2026 Time: 17:45 GMT Sporting vs Bodo Glimt Form and Head to Head Sporting CP head into this clash after a disappointing 3-0 away defeat to Bodo Glimt in the first leg of their Champions League tie. Their recent form has been mixed, with three wins, one draw, and one loss in their last five competitive matches. Highlights include 3-0 victories over Estoril and Moreirense in Liga Portugal, a 1-0 Taça de Portugal win against Porto, and a 2-2 league draw with Braga, which exposed some defensive vulnerabilities. Bodo Glimt arrive in Lisbon on the back of four straight wins, including their 3-0 first-leg victory over Sporting, a 2-1 Cup win over Molde, and two Champions League wins against Inter (2-1 away, 3-1 home). Their recent form underlines a strong attacking threat. This will be only the second competitive meeting between the sides. With the 3-0 first-leg win, Bodo Glimt hold a commanding advantage heading into the return leg. Who is the Betting Favourite in Sporting vs Bodo Glimt? Fotis Ioannidis, Giorgi Kochorashvili, Ricardo Mangas, and G. Quenda are all listed as doubtful for the match. Their potential absence could impact the depth and tactical options available to the home side. Luis Suárez is expected to lead the attack, having been a key attacking player in this Champions League campaign, often striking late in matches. In stark contrast, Bodo Glimt travel to Lisbon with a fully fit squad, providing coach Kjetil Knutsen with a complete complement of players to choose from. Kasper Høgh, who scored five Champions League goals this season, will lead the line, supported by the influential Jens Petter Hauge and Ole Didrik Blomberg, both of whom have been directly involved in multiple goals in recent European outings. Sporting vs Bodo Glimt Confirmed Lineups Sporting (4-2-3-1): R. Silva; M. Araújo, G. Inácio, Quaresma, I. Fresneda; Morita, M. Hjulmand; Goncalves, Trincão, G. Catamo; L. Suárez. Bodo/Glimt (4-3-3): N. Haikin; F. Bjørkan, J. Gundersen, O. Bjørtuft, F. Sjøvold; S. Fet, P. Berg, H. Evjen; J. P. Hauge, K. Høgh, O. D. Blomberg. Lineups powered by WhoScored. Sporting vs Bodo Glimt Team Prediction Sporting CP face a huge challenge at Estádio José Alvalade as they look to overturn a 3–0 first-leg deficit against Bodo Glimt. The Norwegian side produced a stunning display in the opener, and Sporting will rely on their strong home form. They have won all four Champions League games at José Alvalade this season, scoring 11 and conceding just three. Sporting thrive on wing play, through balls, and long-range shots, but they can struggle with offside traps and defending counters. Bodo Glimt, dangerous on the break and down the flanks, have never lost to Portuguese teams in Europe. While they can be vulnerable to individual errors and set pieces, their attacking consistency, scoring in seven straight Champions League games and in 14 consecutive away matches, makes them tough to beat. Expect Sporting to fight hard at home, but the three-goal deficit and Bodo Glimt’s resilience make a comeback unlikely.
